entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane of kithkin, merrows, giants, faeries, boggarts, flamekin, elves, treefolk and changelings.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: Small folk bound by the thoughtweft, living in clachans.

entities.name: Thoughtweft
entities.description: The shared thought-bond that ties a kithkin clachan together.

entities.name: Giants
entities.description: Long-lived, grudge-keeping giantkind who barely notice small folk.

entities.name: Merrows
entities.description: Water folk organized in schools along the Merrow Lanes.

entities.name: Merrow Lanes
entities.description: The water routes of Lorwyn the merrow navigate and monitor.

entities.name: Dark Meanders
entities.description: A deep watery region of Lorwyn.

entities.name: Inkfathom school
entities.description: A merrow school of divers.

entities.name: Silvergill school
entities.description: A merrow school that monitors Lane traffic.

entities.name: Stonybrook school
entities.description: A merrow school.

entities.name: Faeries
entities.description: Pranksters who steal dreamstuff for their queen.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The hidden queen of the faeries, living in Glen Elendra and nourished by secrets and dreams.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: A hidden valley sheltered by glamers where Oona dwells.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: Hoarding-averse creatures who share all treasures and have aunties.

entities.name: Flamekin
entities.description: Fire folk led by demagogues, who fear the elves.

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: Beauty-obsessed elves, divided into castes, who hunt eyeblights.

entities.name: Eyeblights
entities.description: Elves deemed too ugly to exist, hunted by winnowers.

entities.name: Treefolk
entities.description: Ancient tree beings fond of kithkin.

entities.name: Changelings
entities.description: Shapeshifters that mimic nearby beings, born at Velis Vel.

entities.name: Velis Vel
entities.description: A cavern of Lorwyn where changelings are born and congregate.

entities.name: Gaddock Teeg
entities.description: A wise kithkin often quoted on giants and faeries.

entities.name: Deagan
entities.description: The cenn of Burrenton.

entities.name: Burrenton
entities.description: A clachan of smiths.

entities.name: Brigid, Hero of Kinsbaile
entities.description: A champion archer who extended Kinsbaile's borders.

entities.name: Kinsbaile

entities.name: Minnarin
entities.description: A merrow reejerey.

entities.name: Neerdiv
entities.description: A fallowsage.

entities.description: A merrow of the Stonybrook school.

entities.name: Illulia
entities.description: A flamekin soulstoke.

entities.name: Eidren
entities.description: A perfect of Lys Alana who ordered trees uprooted and rearranged, birthing the Gilt-Leaf Wood.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
entities.description: A forest arranged by Eidren in a pattern he deemed beautiful.

entities.name: Lys Alana

entities.name: Dawn's Light Palace

entities.name: Wren's Run
entities.description: A shaded place in Lys Alana.

entities.name: Desmera

entities.name: Nath of the Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: A savage hunter with a prince's bearing.

entities.name: Smik

entities.description: A boggart auntie in tales.

events.summary: Eidren orders hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a beautiful pattern, creating the Gilt-Leaf Wood.
events.quote: Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana, ordered hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a pattern he deemed beautiful.

events.summary: Desmera blinds her seers so her beauty is the last image they see.
events.quote: Desmera blinded her seers so that her beauty would be the last image burned in their memories.

events.summary: Auntie Flint lends axes to Nibb and Gyik, who never return.
events.quote: Auntie Flint lent axes to Nibb and Gyik

events.summary: Snokk flees as hooves grow louder, hunted by a hunter of eyeblights.
events.quote: Snokk ran as fast as he could, but the sound of hooves grew ever louder in his ears.

events.summary: Smik learns the elvish dance and must stay out of Nath's sight until called to perform.
events.quote: Smik learned the elvish dance quickly enough.

events.summary: A newborn boggart is declared to look like Byoog.
Bulgo is turned into a tree by Lignify.
